offers_products.reason: Manufactures street sweepers, sewer cleaners, vacuum trucks, dump truck bodies, and warning signals and sirens.

offers_services.reason: Directly manages over 40 service centers providing repair, maintenance and parts, though secondary to equipment manufacturing.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells equipment to municipalities, contractors and industrial firms, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Municipalities, government agencies, contractors, utilities and mining companies buy its equipment, often via dealers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from one-off equipment sales; parts and service are a smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers can defer buying sweepers, vacuum trucks and truck bodies when municipal or industrial budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Street sweepers, sewer cleaners, vacuum trucks and dump truck bodies are costly, infrequent purchases for municipalities and contractors.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured equipment, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Municipal governments, utilities and large industrial or mining customers buy sweepers, sewer cleaners and specialty vehicles.

asset_heavy.reason: Assembles specialty vehicles and equipment in plants, sells via dealers; not fleets or networks, moderate manufacturing capital.

notes: Based on recognized company knowledge plus site text; rental and service are smaller parts.
